title: Session cost diff grid — compact delta heatmap & price-slab toggles for Console
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Design and prototype a compact session-level Cost Diff Grid for the Redwood Console. The view surfaces token-level cost deltas between two time slices or two model variants, shows attribution to route/prompt/assistant, and provides price-slab toggles so users can preview how different pricing bands affect invoice estimates. The component must be embeddable in the Route Insights page and exportable to CSV/NDJSON for downstream billing reconciliation.
goals: Enable rapid spotting of cost regressions at token granularity across sessions
Provide an interactive delta heatmap with hover detail and contextual attribution links
Allow product teams to toggle pricing slabs and immediately see recalculated totals
Support 1-click export of selected rows/columns and a full normalized token ledger for finance
constraints_and_assumptions: Data back-end will provide aggregated token cost rows with keys: session_id, route, role, token_type, token_count, base_cost, applied_slab_id
We should prioritize a compact grid to fit inside current Route Insights layout (max height 520px)
Export format must be CSV-first with optional NDJSON for engineering consumers
Accessibility: proper focus states and screen-reader friendly summaries required for the heatmap
proposed_components: Delta Heatmap cell (color by percent change; tooltip shows absolute delta and contributing tokens)
Mini sparkline per-row showing cost trend for the selected comparison window
Price-slab toggle bar (compact chip set) — live recalculation of row totals
Attribution pill that expands into a micro-panel with links to request-level logs and prompt set
Export dropdown: Selected CSV | Full ledger CSV | NDJSON (for SFTP ingest)
acceptance_criteria: Row-level delta values and colors match sample dataset provided by ENG-19844
Price-slab toggles recompute totals within 250ms for up to 200 visible rows
CSV export schema documented and validated with Finance (PM-420) and returns same totals as UI
Prototype vetted with two PMs and one SRE in UX review session
Keyboard navigation across grid cells and descriptive ARIA labels implemented in prototype
engineering_notes: ENG-19844 will deliver aggregated rows and an experiment flag to enable the grid for beta customers
Backend to expose a /cost-grid endpoint returning pre-computed 'delta_score' and 'applied_slab_id' fields
Prefer client-side rendering of heatmap but server-side pagination for large result sets
export_schema_summary: CSV columns: session_id, route, role, token_type, token_count, base_cost_usd, delta_usd, applied_slab_id, recalculated_total_usd
NDJSON: one object per session row with full token breakdown and meta.timestamp
tradeoffs_discussed: Compact vs. full table: compact preserves Route Insights real estate but hides some metadata — we ship compact first, full table in follow-up
Realtime recalculation on slab toggle could be expensive for wide selection — we limit live recalculation to visible rows and add asynchronous recalculation for 'Full selection'
Heatmap color mapping: linear color scale is easier to interpret than log-scale for product managers reviewing smaller regressions
stakeholder_feedback: PM Alvaro Ruiz: prefers per-route default and wants a 'pin to dashboard' action
Finance (Evelyn Shaw): CSV schema looks good but requests an extra column 'invoice_label' to map to accounting systems
SRE (Priya Rao): asked for a fallback to 'summary-only' rows when backend returns partial data
